name: Kirishima Sumire
source:
Wife of the second son, Shinji, and a former executive secretary who quit after marrying. Her sharp, elegant looks might make her seem cold, but she’s deeply compassionate. Though chaste and tidy, she’s surprisingly open-minded, accepting both the pure and the messy sides of life.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/aniyomes/chara.html]official site[/url]]
